ddl.organizations:
CREATE TABLE `organizations` (
  `id` bigint unsigned NOT NULL AUTO_INCREMENT,
  `name` varchar(150) COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci NOT NULL,
  `slug` varchar(150) COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci NOT NULL,
  `description` text COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci,
  `archived_at` timestamp NULL DEFAULT NULL,
  `created_at` timestamp NULL DEFAULT NULL,
  `updated_at` timestamp NULL DEFAULT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY (`id`),
  UNIQUE KEY `organizations_slug_unique` (`slug`)
) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb4 COLLATE=utf8mb4_unicode_ci
ddl.organization_memberships:
CREATE TABLE `organization_memberships` (
  `id` bigint unsigned NOT NULL AUTO_INCREMENT,
  `organization_id` bigint unsigned NOT NULL,
  `user_id` bigint unsigned NOT NULL,
  `role` varchar(20) COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci NOT NULL DEFAULT 'member',
  `status` varchar(20) COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci NOT NULL DEFAULT 'active',
  `created_at` timestamp NULL DEFAULT NULL,
  `updated_at` timestamp NULL DEFAULT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY (`id`),
  UNIQUE KEY `uq_organization_member` (`organization_id`,`user_id`),
  KEY `organization_memberships_user_id_foreign` (`user_id`),
  CONSTRAINT `organization_memberships_organization_id_foreign` FOREIGN KEY (`organization_id`) REFERENCES `organizations` (`id`) ON DELETE RESTRICT,
  CONSTRAINT `organization_memberships_user_id_foreign` FOREIGN KEY (`user_id`) REFERENCES `users` (`id`) ON DELETE RESTRICT
) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb4 COLLATE=utf8mb4_unicode_ci
ddl.teams:
CREATE TABLE `teams` (
  `id` bigint unsigned NOT NULL AUTO_INCREMENT,
  `organization_id` bigint unsigned NOT NULL,
  `name` varchar(150) COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci NOT NULL,
  `lead_user_id` bigint unsigned DEFAULT NULL,
  `archived_at` timestamp NULL DEFAULT NULL,
  `created_at` timestamp NULL DEFAULT NULL,
  `updated_at` timestamp NULL DEFAULT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY (`id`),
  UNIQUE KEY `uq_organization_team_name` (`organization_id`,`name`),
  KEY `teams_lead_user_id_foreign` (`lead_user_id`),
  CONSTRAINT `teams_lead_user_id_foreign` FOREIGN KEY (`lead_user_id`) REFERENCES `users` (`id`) ON DELETE RESTRICT,
  CONSTRAINT `teams_organization_id_foreign` FOREIGN KEY (`organization_id`) REFERENCES `organizations` (`id`) ON DELETE RESTRICT
) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb4 COLLATE=utf8mb4_unicode_ci
ddl.team_memberships:
CREATE TABLE `team_memberships` (
  `id` bigint unsigned NOT NULL AUTO_INCREMENT,
  `team_id` bigint unsigned NOT NULL,
  `user_id` bigint unsigned NOT NULL,
  `status` varchar(20) COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci NOT NULL DEFAULT 'active',
  `created_at` timestamp NULL DEFAULT NULL,
  `updated_at` timestamp NULL DEFAULT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY (`id`),
  UNIQUE KEY `uq_team_member` (`team_id`,`user_id`),
  KEY `team_memberships_user_id_foreign` (`user_id`),
  CONSTRAINT `team_memberships_team_id_foreign` FOREIGN KEY (`team_id`) REFERENCES `teams` (`id`) ON DELETE RESTRICT,
  CONSTRAINT `team_memberships_user_id_foreign` FOREIGN KEY (`user_id`) REFERENCES `users` (`id`) ON DELETE RESTRICT
) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb4 COLLATE=utf8mb4_unicode_ci
ddl.project_team:
CREATE TABLE `project_team` (
  `id` bigint unsigned NOT NULL AUTO_INCREMENT,
  `project_id` bigint unsigned NOT NULL,
  `team_id` bigint unsigned NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY (`id`),
  UNIQUE KEY `uq_project_team` (`project_id`,`team_id`),

  CONSTRAINT `project_team_team_id_foreign` FOREIGN KEY (`team_id`) REFERENCES `teams` (`id`) ON DELETE RESTRICT
) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb4 COLLATE=utf8mb4_unicode_ci
